title: Café Chiffon
blurb: Small café tucked into the Old Cape Quarter courtyard. Good for a slow morning that doesn't turn into a whole plan.
address: SHOP GF007, Old Cape Quarter, 72 Waterkant St, Green Point

title: Truth Coffee Roasting
blurb: Roastery and café on Buitenkant, as known for the steampunk fit-out as the coffee. Busy from opening.
address: 36 Buitenkant St, Cape Town City Centre

title: The Ladder
blurb: Bree Street spot for a long breakfast or a working hour with a flat white.
address: 136 Bree St, Cape Town City Centre

title: The Strangers Club
blurb: Neighbourhood café and bar off Braemar. Quiet in the morning, considerably less so later.

title: Hudsons
blurb: Burgers and a room that stays loud. Go with people, not a book.

title: The Barn Restaurant
blurb: Rondebosch standby on Klipfontein. Unfussy, reliable, easy to get a table.

title: The Hussar Grill
blurb: Steak on Beach Road with the sea across the way. Book if it's a Friday.
address: New Cumberland Building, Beach Rd, Mouille Point

title: Mulberry & Prince
blurb: Pepper Street kitchen doing a short, changing menu. Small room, book ahead.
address: 12 Pepper St, Cape Town City Centre

title: The Happy Uncles
blurb: Halal fine dining on Voortrekker Road. A proper sit-down evening, ten minutes from Woodstock.

title: Cecilia Forest climb
blurb: Pine forest switchbacks up the back of the mountain, with a waterfall if you carry on. Shaded most of the way.

title: Silvermine reservoir walk
blurb: Flat loop around the reservoir with the whole peninsula on either side. Easy enough to talk the whole way.

title: Kloof Corner at golden hour
blurb: Forty-five minutes up, the best view in the city, and back down before dark. Bring a jacket.

title: Newlands Forest run
blurb: Trails under the pines with the contour path if you want more. Cool even when town is baking.

title: MAMMA MIA! at Artscape
blurb: The musical, full staging, at Artscape. The kind of night out you book for other people and then enjoy more than they do.
address: Artscape Theatre Centre, D.F. Malan St, Foreshore

title: WOMAD South Africa
blurb: World music across several stages at Artscape — heritage, collaboration, and a lot of people dancing badly.
address: Artscape Theatre Centre, D.F. Malan St, Foreshore

title: Extreme Festival at Killarney
blurb: Motorsport day at Killarney. Loud, hot, and completely absorbing whether or not you know what you're watching.

title: Clay Café Hout Bay
blurb: Pick a piece, paint it, they fire it and you collect it later. Two hours disappear.
address: 4080 Hout Bay Main Rd, Hout Bay

title: City Rock
blurb: Indoor climbing in Paarden Eiland. Walls for people who've never done it and walls for people who have.

title: Rush Extreme
blurb: Trampolines, foam pits, and a heart rate you weren't expecting. Better with a group.

title: Sunrise kayak from Battery Park
blurb: Out past the harbour wall at first light. Seals most mornings, whales if you're lucky.
address: Battery Park, Dock Rd, V&A Waterfront

title: Acrobranch Hout Bay
blurb: Rope courses through the trees at increasing heights. You will find out quite quickly how you feel about heights.
address: 1 Hout Bay Main Rd, Hout Bay

title: Tandem paraglide off Signal Hill
blurb: Run off the side of Signal Hill strapped to someone who's done it a thousand times. Landing is on the Sea Point side.

title: Evening class at The Chefs Studio
blurb: Bree Street kitchen, a small class, and something you can actually cook again on a Tuesday.
address: 103 Bree St, Cape Town City Centre

title: Cooking with Faeeza
blurb: Home kitchen in the Bo-Kaap. You cook, you eat what you cooked, and you leave with the recipes.

title: Bo-Kaap cooking tour
blurb: Walk the neighbourhood, then cook in it. Half history lesson, half lunch.

title: Wheel throwing at Clay Hands
blurb: Two hours at the wheel on Victoria Road. You will make something wonky and you will keep it.

title: Make a ring in a day
blurb: Silversmithing in a Gardens studio — cut, solder, file, polish, wear it home.

title: Clay Café Century City
blurb: Same idea as Hout Bay, closer to town, and indoors when the wind is up.

title: Zeitz MOCAA
blurb: Contemporary African art inside a converted grain silo. Worth it for the atrium alone.

title: Artscape Theatre Centre
blurb: The city's main stage. Whatever's on this week, it's on here.

title: SAFRA Heritage Gala
blurb: An evening of heritage performance in Parow. Dress for it.

title: Cape Ballet Africa
blurb: Contemporary ballet from a young company. Shorter than you expect and much better.

title: Sewing studio evening
blurb: Lower Main Road studio with machines, patterns and someone to stop you ruining the fabric.

title: YOLO Fiesta
blurb: Long Street, loud, late. Go if that's the evening you're after.
address: 38 Long St, Cape Town City Centre

title: Cape Town Fashion Week
blurb: Runway shows at Kenilworth Racecourse. Half the interest is the crowd outside.
address: Hollywoodbets Kenilworth Racecourse, 105 Rosmead Ave, Kenilworth

title: Nantes Heritage Race
blurb: Road race through Athlone with a community behind it. Entry on the day.

title: Sanlam Cape Town Marathon
blurb: The big one. Green Point start, the whole city out on the pavement.

title: Run the promenade
blurb: Flat, lit, and busy with other runners. The easiest 5k in the city to commit to.

title: Ladles of Love packing shift
blurb: Two hours on the line in Epping packing meals. Go with someone; the time passes faster.
address: Unit 4, Hewett Park, 17 Hewett Ave, Epping

title: Islamic Relief volunteer morning
blurb: Sorting and distribution from the Lansdowne office. Show up, they'll find you a job.

title: Gift of the Givers packing
blurb: Disaster-response packing in Belthorn. Unglamorous and completely worth the morning.

title: SANCCOB seabird centre
blurb: Penguin and seabird rehabilitation in Table View. You can visit, and you can help.

title: Two Oceans Aquarium
blurb: Where two oceans meet, indoors, with a kelp forest tank you'll stand in front of for longer than planned.

title: Trash Bash beach clean
blurb: An hour on Sunrise Beach with bags and gloves, followed by coffee. Genuinely satisfying.

title: Greenpop planting day
blurb: Tree planting run out of the Mountain Road hub in Woodstock. Dirt under the fingernails, four blocks from here.

title: The Grotto Spa
blurb: Hydrotherapy and quiet up at Greys Pass. Go in wound up, come out useless.

title: The Seasonal Reset
blurb: An afternoon at Nova Core to stop and take stock. More practical than it sounds.
address: Nova Core, 47 De Villiers St, Zonnebloem

title: Flow Lab Friday
blurb: Breathwork and movement on Loop Street to close out the week. Ninety minutes, no experience needed.
address: Habitus Wellness, 61 Loop St, Cape Town City Centre

title: Padel at Stadium on Main
blurb: Easiest racket sport to pick up and the hardest to stop playing. Courts book out after five.
address: Mezzanine level, Stadium on Main, 99 Main Rd, Claremont

title: Learn to surf at Muizenberg
blurb: Gary's has been putting beginners on boards at Surfers Corner for decades. Wetsuit included.

title: Cape Town Cycle Tour
blurb: 109km around the peninsula with thirty thousand other people. Train for it or suffer beautifully.

title: Story Jam
blurb: True stories told live on Loop Street by people who are not performers. Consistently the best night out in town.
address: 35 Loop St, Cape Town City Centre

title: First Thursdays
blurb: Galleries and shops stay open late and the whole city centre walks around. Start on Church Street.
address: 1 Orphan Ln, Cape Town City Centre

title: Quiz night in Obz
blurb: Lower Main Road, teams of four, and one round you will argue about afterwards.
